$comment: Release gate for triage behaviour on tests/fixtures/golden/risk_classifier_v1.jsonl. CI fails if any metric breaches its limit, and on a pull request fails if any limit is loosened compared with the base branch. Tighten limits as the classifier improves; to loosen one deliberately, fill in loosening_reason and it is printed in the run summary. costPerReviewUsd is the mean measured model cost per review read, in US$ (owner's limit of one cent, set 2026-11-13 before any run).
loosening_reason: 2026-11-13, merging PR #8 into PR #6 (policy-v1.2.0): falseAlarm max goes 1 -> 4 in both modes. PR #8's fail-closed routing (merged by the owner) holds 5-star praise it cannot confirm in readable English (golden RC-003, RC-512, RC-520, RC-531), and the second reader can only raise, so 4 is a floor in both modes. In return, rules_only unsafe quick approves fall 6 -> 1 (limit tightened to 1), sensitive recall rises to 56.7% (min 0.56) and exact match to 30/49 (min 0.61). Whether a reader may confirm such praise is an open owner decision (DECISIONS 18).
